title: Mixer Tricks
intro: The Mixer is where a collection of good parts becomes a record. These are the organisational and workflow tricks — the ones that stop a 60‑track session from becoming unmanageable.

tips.t: X toggles the Mixer, and it remembers your scroll position
tips.d: Flip between arrangement and mixer constantly. It costs nothing.

tips.t: Use the Single view to see one channel and its full signal path
tips.d: The Mixer's view buttons switch between All, Single and Tracks. Single shows the selected channel plus every bus it feeds — the fastest way to debug routing.

tips.t: Filter the mixer by channel type
tips.d: The buttons along the top of the Mixer show or hide audio, instrument, aux, bus, VCA and master channels. Hide everything but auxes when you are setting up sends.

tips.t: ⌥‑click any control to reset it to default
tips.d: Faders to 0, pans to centre, sends to their default. Works on every control in the mixer.

tips.t: ⌥‑click a Solo or Mute to apply it everywhere
tips.d: Instantly mute or unmute the entire mixer.

tips.t: Use VCA faders for level groups without changing routing
tips.d: A VCA controls the faders of its member channels without summing them through a bus, so your existing routing and sends are untouched.

tips.t: Use Summing Stacks for processing groups
tips.d: Select tracks and hit ⌘⇧D. Everything routes to one aux you can compress and EQ as a unit.

tips.t: Create a send and Logic makes the aux for you
tips.d: Click any Send slot and choose an unused bus. The aux channel appears automatically, already receiving.

tips.t: Set sends to pre‑fader for headphone mixes and effects that must stay constant
tips.d: Right‑click a send to switch between pre and post fader. Post is right for reverb; pre is right for a cue mix.

tips.t: Copy a whole channel strip with ⌥‑drag
tips.d: Drag the channel strip settings area from one channel to another while holding ⌥ to copy every insert, send and setting.

tips.t: Colour your channels to match your regions
tips.d: Mixer channels take the track colour. A consistent colour scheme means you find the vocal bus without reading a single label.

tips.t: ⌥‑click an insert slot to see the plugin menu without loading
tips.d: And ⇧‑click an insert to bypass it without opening it.

tips.t: V hides every open plugin window at once
tips.d: Press it again and they all come back exactly where they were. Essential on a laptop screen.

tips.t: Drag plugins between insert slots and between channels
tips.d: Reorder your chain by dragging, and hold ⌥ while dragging to another channel to copy rather than move.
